import pytest
import sys
import io
import os
import tempfile
from click._utils import UNSET
import click

def test_prompt_backspace_behavior(runner, monkeypatch):
    # Mock the input to simulate backspace behavior
    monkeypatch.setattr('sys.stdin', io.StringIO('a\b\b'))

    @click.command()
    def cli():
        return click.prompt('Enter text')

    result = runner.invoke(cli, [], standalone_mode=False, catch_exceptions=False)
    assert result.output == 'Enter text: '
